package.name: l5_track_family
package.description: L5 canary for the raceline tracker on the track family (tests/l5_track_family): the real command path (racer_gym_bridge, racer_safety safety_node, racer_control tracker_node) on a stadium and a rounded-rectangle lane of 1 m, both directions, with the car as measured on 2026-11-10 (per-side steering locks) and the raceline made from the track's own map by tools/track_session. Uses tests/l5_reactive_bench/track_family_runner.py.
